ResourceHeader.ResourceName: IBEX High Energy Neutral Atom Imager (Hi) Data Release 18, no Compton-Getting correction, no Survival Probability correction, ANTIRAM Solar Ecliptic ENA Maps, Level H3, fourteen-year combined Data

RevisionEvent.Note: Initial release of metadata, ADAPT generated, LFB
Curated and checked for SPASE 2.7.2 structural and semantic consistency, OK

ResourceHeader.Description: IBEX-Hi Release 18 fourteen-year combined hydrogen energetic neutral atom (ENA) maps from antiram-direction observations, with documented coverage from 2008-12-25 through 2022-12-26. The product contains one combined map per energy channel. Epoch and Epoch2 bound its accumulation interval; Fexp2-Fexp6 give the total exposure time accumulated for each pixel within that interval. Neither Compton-Getting nor survival-probability correction has been applied. The fluxes are not corrected for spacecraft motion or scaled from near 1 AU to approximately 100 AU by those corrections. Maps use a 60 by 30 Solar Ecliptic grid at six-degree spacing, with West_Longitude and Latitude as the first and second array dimensions. Channels 2-6 have nominal energies of 0.71, 1.11, 1.74, 2.73, and 4.29 keV; Ener2-Ener6 provide the energy arrays associated with the pixels. Parameters include differential flux, flux variance, signal-to-noise ratio, total counts, total exposure time, and samples per pixel averaged over the measurement interval, together with time, map, coordinate, and orbit support variables. The *_plasma variables provide virtual CDAWeb X/Y alternate views. These virtual variables reference the corresponding base arrays and have no independently stored data records in the CDF. The CDAWeb ProductKey is IBEX_H3_ENA_HI_R18_NOCG_NOSP_ANTIRAM_14YR.
